Title: Use action of a equipment twice

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
Name: Camera Phone
[LotN:C/PG2, KoT:C, HttB:PSam3]
Cardtype: Equipment
Electronic equipment.
The minion with this equipment may bleed at +1 bleed as a  action. No other equipment can increase the bleed amount of this action.
Artist: Craig Grant

If you use this equipment with a minion and then move the equipment to another minion can the new minion use the action of the equipment again?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Coyote wrote:
> Name: Camera Phone
> [LotN:C/PG2, KoT:C, HttB:PSam3]
> Cardtype: Equipment
> Electronic equipment.
> The minion with this equipment may bleed at +1 bleed as a  action. No other equipment can increase the bleed amount of this action.
> Artist: Craig Grant
>
> If you use this equipment with a minion and then move the equipment to another minion can the new minion use the action of the equipment again?
>
Nothing prevents it.
The "no repeat action" rule prevent a single minion from doing the same action more than once, not two different minions from doing the same action.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
